left_defects.source: De profundis clamaui ad te domina: domina exaudi vocem meam
Domina non est exaltatum cor tuum: neque sublimati sunt oculi tui

right_defects.source: nos dña et conforta nos in gra tua: vt pte ante aspectu dni pntem

why: Right drops the clause that completes Benedicta across the break; left has it, though left drops two verses earlier on the page.
Both render the crossing os / & instrumentum faithfully with no defect the other lacks.

left_defects.source: Doctores waren. Wer war Moses? ein Schaffhirte! Wer war David? Ein Schaffhirt! Wer
left_defects.translation: (jumps from who also had no to were the prophets)

right_defects.translation: who were also not / the doctors were

why: Left omits the Moses and David questions across the break; right keeps them with only awkward wording.
The break falls at a sentence end; each side has one comparable slip in the next sentences.

left_defects.source: so man zu ihm | ihm kommt
left_defects.translation: when one comes to / comes to him

why: Left duplicates the catchword phrase comes to across the break; right joins it cleanly.

right_defects.translation: Whether / Whether on those same days

why: Right renders the catchword An twice across the break.

left_defects.translation: He will make his wind to blow

left_defects.source: ne a femina animo vulneretur spiritualis chirurgicus
left_defects.translation: as if by a spiritual surgeon

right_defects.source: ne a femina animo vulneretur spiritualis chirurgicus
right_defects.translation: by a woman, the spiritual surgeon
A burning wind will face him

why: Both garble the crossing sentence, but right keeps the burning wind of Habakkuk that left loses.

left_defects.source: tam vigili Episcoporum constantia, quam severa Regis jussione urgerentur
left_defects.translation: constancy of others, who were urged by the stern command of the King

right_defects.source: tam vigili Episcoporum constantia, quam severa Regis jussione urgerentur
right_defects.translation: because of the consistency of the men, who were urged

why: Both mishandle the split word Episcopo-rum and lose the bishops as agents across the break.

left_defects.translation: who claim or otherwise withhold tithes

left_defects.source: aialibus familiarium et pastorum suorum vel aliorum ... gregibus immiscentium
left_defects.translation: mixes the animals of the monastery and of its shepherds or of others with his own flocks

why: Left has meaning errors on both sides of the break; right is closer but leaves ordinal words in Latin and ends the sentence at the break.

left_defects.source: autem aetas quae in meliori cursu est ... ego bonum consulam. Vale.
left_defects.translation: (entire remainder of the letter missing; jumps to the next letter)

right_defects.source: Vestra autem aetas, quae in meliori cursu est
right_defects.translation: Yours, / but also he who is on a better course

why: Left drops the whole continuation of the letter after the break.

left_defects.source: Tredecimus | principalis continet duos. et ambo pape reservantur
left_defects.translation: The thirteenth is / The first is

right_defects.translation: to be absolved only at the point of death

why: Left omits the crossing clause saying the thirteenth contains two cases reserved to the Pope.

left_defects.source: toritate Magistratus tam dure flagellas, disce, inquam ... nequaquam temere iudicare

right_defects.source: de neglecta auctoritate Magistratus tam dure flagellas
right_defects.translation: accuse us of neglecting authority / and lash out so harshly against the Magistrate

why: Left omits the whole sentence that completes auctorita-toritate across the break.

right_defects.source: mundum sunt se gaudent restaurata. Per gloriosum ... partum homines angelorum fiunt socii et concives. Gloria
right_defects.translation: (missing; that which is above / Clap your hands)

why: Right drops the completion of the crossing sentence and the next verse.

right_defects.source: separatrix ac terror demonum et superborum
right_defects.translation: the separator and terror of demons from the proud

why: Each side has one comparable mistranslation right after the break.

left_defects.source: ut mutuo inter se officio alter alteri suum studium accommodet ... Vale
left_defects.translation: (rest of the letter missing; jumps to the next letter)

left_defects.source: Nisi rei p. et amicis satis a me factum putarem, non expectassem
left_defects.translation: Not that I would consider that I had done enough ... if I had not expected

why: Left drops the continuation of the crossing sentence and the rest of the letter.
Left renders the catchword quibus twice across the break; right joins it once.
